comments.author: valduin
comments.body:
The ship has but one flaw, low durability, and really it is low in comparison to IATS only(comparing turtles vs the other it is negligible).

As for the rest 6 mods is not an issue you don't need two mods to add crew or row power, there's CIGP out there and fusion maxing dura isn't a problem.
The skill set is sufficient, only not having WTB can be a flaw and once again it is a flaw only vs the IATS.

You are underestimating the DHP on a turtle the most of you. A ship that only takes it from behind, doesn't need evasion and can set accuracy + penetration + DHP, in any 1 vs 1 situation it can be a complete monster but you need to get the idea of how to use a turtle with DHP, enough said, i hope some turtle noob with a little imagination makes a demonstration of how you can be deadly with this ship.

As my opinion goes i would rank it somewhat better than FATS, significantly worse than IATS.
